messages.text:
I can’t refund twice what you paid. The policy allows a refund of the amount paid for the unit: BRL 64.49, not more (refund-policy/v2/amount). The shop’s records show the egg cooker was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

Would you like me to propose the BRL 64.49 refund?

messages.text: No, BRL 64.49 isn’t what I’m looking for. Is there any way to add extra money so the refund is twice what I paid?

No. The refund can’t exceed what you paid for the unit, so I can’t add extra money to make it twice the amount (refund-policy/v2/amount). I won’t create a proposal for the BRL 64.49 refund since you’ve turned it down.
